# Test fixtures

## face_golden_portrait.jpg

Resized (ffmpeg `scale=400:-1`) from the official White House photograph
"President Barack Obama" by Pete Souza (December 6, 2012), a work of the
U.S. federal government and therefore in the public domain.

Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama.jpg

Used by `tests/test_face_detect.py` as a golden-detection fixture for the
YuNet face detector (single frontal face, known approximate bounding box).
